scale.+5: Strongly champions this Kanon ideal (words for A, deeds for B)
scale.0: Silent, neutral, or only self-interested on this topic
scale.-5: Actively opposes, undermines or extracts from this ideal
scale.null: No evidence found. NEVER guess a number without evidence.

columns.A: Stated Should: what the figure SAID should happen (speeches, writing, interviews, letters)
columns.B: Actual Would: what the figure actually DID (laws passed, votes, decisions, money, actions, conduct)

questions.title: Australian Character, Mateship & Quiet Grit
questions.A: Did they praise mateship, loyalty between equals and quiet toughness as the core of being Australian?
questions.B: Did they act with loyalty to ordinary people and stick by them under pressure?

questions.title: The Level Playing Field & The Fair Go
